name: h2a
description: h2a — the single sentropic CLI/plugin for human-centered coordination of conversational and coding agents. Bundles the h2a coordination bus (MCP) plus the read-only track-mcp system of record. Skills (h2a + track + harness) are rendered onto the host on demand by `h2a install-skills` from each package's single source — never copied into the plugin.
